name: Wuxi Huadong Heavy Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuxi Huadong Heavy Machinery Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells container handling equipment and intelligent CNC machine tools in China and internationally. It provides quay cranes, rail-mounted gantry cranes, and rubber-tired gantry cranes used in port operations; chips, chip modules, and software and hardware technical solutions; photovoltaic cells and other services; computer numerical control machine tools; and CNC equipment materials The company also involved in the road freight transportation; and designing, manufacturing, installation, modification, and repair of special equipment; chip design and solutions. Wuxi Huadong Heavy Machinery Co., Ltd. was founded in 1989 and is based in Wuxi…
